**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW).**

- **Section 14(a)** (p0064) chose Delaware law but exclusive New York venue — a mismatched pairing that matches neither checklist level.
- **Section 8** (p0028) mandates AAA arbitration for "[a]ny controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement," which contradicts and displaces the exclusive court forum, so the fallback dispute-forum element fails materially.

Redline (validated, preferred level): Delaware → New York law; venue clarified to New York County; the mandatory arbitration sentence deleted and the heading conformed to "Jury Trial Waiver," preserving the jury-trial waiver and one-year limitation period verbatim.
